title: Chicken Tikka Masala
teaser: A creamy, mildly spiced curry using shop-bought tikka paste to keep things fast.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4-5 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in the curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 12-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the cream, warm through, and serve with rice.

title: Chicken Katsu Curry
teaser: Crispy breaded chicken with a mild, slightly sweet Japanese-style curry sauce.
steps: Coat the chicken in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, and fry in oil for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Slice.
Meanwhile, soften the onion in a little oil for 4 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the stock, then simmer for 8-10 minutes until thickened. Stir in the honey.
Serve the sliced chicken over rice with the curry sauce poured over.

title: Mince Keema Curry
teaser: A spiced mince curry that's quicker to make than most curries since there's no meat to cut up.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 12-15 minutes.
Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes of cooking, and serve with rice.

title: Salmon & Spinach Curry
teaser: A milder, quicker curry that keeps the salmon in large flakes rather than breaking it up.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the salmon cubes and cook gently for 4-5 minutes until just cooked through.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, and serve over rice.

title: Thai Green Chicken Curry
teaser: A fragrant, coconut-based curry that comes together fast using shop-bought green curry paste.

ingredients.item: Handful Thai basil or regular basil

steps: Fry the curry paste in a little oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes until lightly coloured.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pepper and fish sauce, and simmer for a further 5 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the basil and serve with rice.

title: Coconut Chickpea Curry
teaser: A vegetarian curry that's mostly tinned and store-cupboard ingredients.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and coconut milk, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and simmer for a further 8-10 minutes until thickened.
Season to taste and serve with rice.

title: Butternut Squash & Chickpea Curry
teaser: A vegetarian curry built on soft roasted squash and chickpeas simmered in coconut milk.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger in a little oil for 4-5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the squash and coconut milk, and simmer for 15-18 minutes until the squash is tender.
Stir in the chickpeas and simmer for a further 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice.

title: Butter Chicken Curry
teaser: A rich, buttery tomato curry that's milder and creamier than a tikka masala.
steps: Melt half the butter in a pan and fry the onion, garlic, and ginger for 4-5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garam masala and chilli powder, and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes until lightly coloured.
Pour in the passata and simmer for 12-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the cream and remaining butter, warm through, and serve with rice.
